question: Who delivered the main address at the closing ceremony of the 38th National Games held in Uttarakhand in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• The **38th National Games** were hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand** from **January 28 to February 14, 2025**.

• The closing ceremony of the event was held on **February 14, 2025**, at the **Maharana Pratap Sports College** in **Dehradun**.

• **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**, the **Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports**, delivered the main address during the closing ceremony, praising the athletes and the state's organizational efforts.

• The ceremony marked the formal conclusion of the games, where the **National Games flag** was handed over to the representatives of the next host state.

• While **Pushkar Singh Dhami**, the **Chief Minister of Uttarakhand**, was a key dignitary present, the primary address at the national-level closing was delivered by the Union Sports Minister.

**Additional Information__**

• The official mascot for the **38th National Games** was the **Himalayan Monal**, which is the state bird of **Uttarakhand**.

• The games were conducted across various venues in cities like **Dehradun**, **Haldwani**, **Rudrapur**, and **Rishikesh**, featuring 38 different sports disciplines.

• The **39th National Games** are scheduled to be held in the state of **Chhattisgarh**.

• The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** is the apex body that oversees the organization of the National Games in India, aiming to identify and nurture sporting talent for international events.
